raised: The page never says what the current account costs in shekels; the cost table only points to the bank's price list
No real interest rates are given, so deposits, money market funds and the current account can't be compared
The coloured-number key ('123 מקמר / חושב / הזנתם') and the word 'מקמר' are confusing
Didn't understand the basic vs extended fee packages or what they would cost
The calculator assumes a 5% return, but a current account pays nothing or almost nothing, so where does the 5% come from?
Unclear which figure is shown: 'בכסף של היום' or 'בשקלים של העתיד'
Nothing suggests entering 0% to see what happens to money left in the current account
The BANK-20/23/15 (and BANK OQ9) codes mean nothing to the reader
Text in 'כסף נכנס ויוצא' is cut off between the pictures
The dark red strip 'שאלה פתוחה: TXI OQ11' looks like a warning, but it isn't clear what it's about
Worried that Israel has no deposit insurance and the 250,000 ₪ protection is only a proposal
'מה האתר לקח בחשבון', full of padlocks and 'חסום', reads like internal notes; would drop it
The terms table appears twice
The chart colours (green area, pink line, pale line) have no labels
The 62,681 deposits figure doesn't match 10,000 + 500/month over 10 years (70,000)
Unclear whether the 'מזומן שקלי' chip is clickable or just a label
Couldn't find how much is lost each year by leaving money at 0% while prices rise
Couldn't find how much to keep in the current account for everyday needs
Couldn't find whether a money market fund is protected if the fund company or bank fails
Couldn't find what to say to the bank
Would drop the 'כסף נכנס ויוצא' cards about moving shares

problems.why: The reader objects that the growth calculator assumes an investment return (5%) that has nothing to do with a current account paying nothing, which is the same complaint as the person's, even though the rate differs.
